A tripod stand designed for the Nebula Mars and Nebula Prizm projectors.
Made of lightweight steel so it stands up to frequent indoor and outdoor use.
Fold up the legs, slide down the base and retract the extending mount to carry the stand with you or put it away without any hassle.
A 360-degree swivel and 180-degree tilt let you set the perfect viewing angle anywhere.
The 6mm screw-tip base fits cameras, video recorders and projectors for steady recording and viewing.
